description: Capture the current RPG Maker MV playtest frame through the authenticated MCP bridge and save it as a PNG under `.mcp-cache/screenshots/`. Returns `{path, bytes, mimeType, name}` and the PNG itself as an image block (up to 1.5 MB; RPGMV_INLINE_IMAGES=0 turns that off), so you can look at it. Requires `manage_system` actions `install_bridge_plugin`, `bridge_start`, and `playtest` first. Optional `name` becomes a safe filename prefix; each capture keeps a timestamp. `manage_system {action:"bridge_screenshot"}` remains available as a compatibility alias.

mapId.description: Render this map headless as the engine draws it, with no game running (PNG under .mcp-cache/renders/). Needs the optional playwright-core and a cached Chromium (npx playwright install chromium-headless-shell, or RPGMAKER_MCP_CHROMIUM).

name.description: Optional safe filename prefix, e.g. boss-room or collision-proof

runEvents.description: mapId: let autorun/parallel events run before the shot (default false)

showPlayer.description: mapId: draw the player (default: hidden for the whole map, shown for a view)

switches.description: mapId: switch IDs to turn ON first, to see later event pages

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the game response in milliseconds (default 15000)

x.description: mapId: with y, a normal screen view centred on this tile instead of the whole map

name: take_screenshot
